sections.t: Lower B was planned but not logged; only two recovery walks (2.7 km and 1.5 km). Walks are recovery, not training, so Friday counts as a missed session.

Upper B: seated cable row, single-arm DB row, rear delt fly, cable lateral raise, triceps pushdown, hammer curl, lying leg raise, suitcase carry, then an easy 3 km run. Keep the run at 8:30 to 9:00/km or slower; if you can't speak in full sentences, slow down.

Lifting plus a run today, so you need the carbs as well as the protein. Have a Skyr berry bowl before the gym and the Chicken and potato tray bake afterwards, and spread the 130 g of protein across all meals within about 1,750 kcal.

Only one session done this week: Wednesday's Upper A and easy run and Friday's Lower B were missed. If today's 3 km run goes well, keep tomorrow's long run to about 3.3 km instead of the planned 3.6 km to stay within 10% of your longest recent run.
